source: Range from 2002, the first full year of the five-day working week of the Labour Code (art. 129 as amended by the Act of 1 March 2001, Dz.U. 2001 nr 28 poz. 301, in force 2001-05-01), with Saturday and Sunday as the weekend by the common practice of that week. Before it Saturday was a working day apart from days set aside year by year, which this calendar does not hold. Holidays: the Non-working Days Act of 18 January 1951 (Dz.U. 1951 nr 4 poz. 28) as amended, and the Act of 7 November 2018. Not in it: days off given only to government offices, and a day off a regulation may name under art. 1a of the 1951 Act during an epidemic
